en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with two- and three‑story buildings. A few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn carriage appear in the distance. Along the right side is a long building with multiple shuttered windows and German signage. At the bottom in red print are the captions identifying the town as Kamenz and the street as Untere Bautznerstrasse, with a small publisher credit beneath.
